hooks.command: g='git([[:space:]]+(-[Cc]|--(git-dir|work-tree|namespace|config-env))[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+'; c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s\n' "$c" | tr ';|&' '\n' | grep -E "$g"'push([[:space:]]|$)' | grep -Eq -e '(^|[[:space:]])(-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*|--force|--force-with-lease|--force-if-includes)([=[:space:]]|$)' -e '[[:space:]][+][^[:space:]]' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git push の force 系オプションは禁止。リモートを巻き戻すおそれがあるため、必要なら人が手で実行する。"}}'; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq 'git[[:space:]]+commit' || exit 0; command -v git-secrets >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git secrets --scan --cached >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"staged の内容が git-secrets のパターンに一致した。git secrets --scan --cached で確認し、誤検知なら .gitallowed に追加する。"}}'; exit 0

g='git([[:space:]]+(-[Cc]|--(git-dir|work-tree|namespace|config-env))[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+'; c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s\n' "$c" | tr ';|&' '\n' | while IFS= read -r l; do m() { printf '%s' " $l" | grep -Eq -e "$1"; }; { m "$g"'reset([[:space:]]|$).*--hard' || m "$g"'checkout[[:space:]].*(--|\.)([[:space:]]|$)' || m "$g"'(checkout|switch)(.*[[:space:]])?(-f|--force|--discard-changes)([[:space:]]|$)' || m "$g"'clean(.*[[:space:]])?(--force|-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*)([[:space:]]|$)' || { m "$g"'restore([[:space:]]|$)' && { ! m '[[:space:]](--staged|-[a-zA-Z]*S[a-zA-Z]*)([[:space:]]|$)' || m '[[:space:]](--worktree|-[a-zA-Z]*W[a-zA-Z]*)([[:space:]]|$)'; }; } || m "$g"'rm([[:space:]].*)?[[:space:]](--force|-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*)([[:space:]]|$)'; } && { echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"未コミットの変更を捨てる操作。"}}'; break; }; done; exit 0

g='git([[:space:]]+(-[Cc]|--(git-dir|work-tree|namespace|config-env))[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+'; c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s\n' "$c" | tr ';|&' '\n' | grep -Eq -e "$g"'branch([[:space:]].*)?[[:space:]](--force|-[a-zA-Z]*[DMCf][a-zA-Z]*)([[:space:]]|$)' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"ブランチを強制的に消す・上書きする操作。マージされていないコミットを失うおそれがある。"}}'; exit 0

jq -c '{time: (now | todate), cwd, session_id, tool_name, tool_input} | walk(if type == "string" then gsub("(?<k>[A-Za-z0-9_]*(_KEY|_PASSWORD|_SECRET|_TOKEN))=[^\\s\"\\x27;&|]+"; "\(.k)=***") | gsub("Bearer [^\\s\"\\x27;&|]+"; "Bearer ***") else . end)' >> ~/.claude/permission-requests.jsonl; exit 0
